## 构建

根目录 `CMakeLists.txt` 是顶层构建脚本（`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)`，`project(lingmo-screenshot)`）。

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```

## 依赖

`debian/control` 的 `Build-Depends` 共 8 项：

- `cmake`
- `debhelper (>= 9)`
- `extra-cmake-modules`
- `qtbase5-dev`
- `qtdeclarative5-dev`
- `qtquickcontrols2-5-dev`
- `qttools5-dev`
- `qttools5-dev-tools`

顶层 `CMakeLists.txt` 用 `find_package` 查找 1 个包：`Qt5`。
